notes: Complete, verbatim copy of the Vonage (Nexmo) SMS API OpenAPI 3.0 document (v1.2.0) as published to apis.guru from Vonage's own API specification repository. The SMS API is a single endpoint — POST {https://rest.nexmo.com/sms}/{format} — with 9 component schemas covering the request, the per-message response and every error shape; that one operation IS the whole API, and it is what the adaptor's only operation (sendSMS) calls. Vonage publishes separate specs for its other products (voice, verify, messages, number insight); those are different APIs, and the nexmo adaptor exports no generic request builders that could reach them. Replaces a 4 KiB hand-authored spec.
